statement: The input is a Python 3 function that is meant to return how many of the integers in the list xs are even. It contains exactly one bug: an off-by-one, a wrong operator, or a wrong initial value. Fix the bug, then evaluate the corrected function for the call `count_evens([-22, -2, 21, -48, -8, 47, -21, -29, -42])`. Answer with the integer it returns.
title: Blue belt: fix count_evens
